title: Finite operation data for normalized localization
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sf-qbar-localization-finite-coherence and complementary immersions i and j, there exists a finite operation package consisting of the normalized finite localization orthogonality records, compact-support coefficient action, closed and pullback stage-system morphisms, their finite formulas, and their canonical pullback beta comparisons. The ingredients are [lem-sf-rational-localization-triangle-orthogonality], [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action], and [def-sf-qbar-localization-finite-data].

proof.text: Construct the normalized rational localization records at every finite coefficient field, the compact-support action, and the canonical pullback stage-system maps with their prescribed finite formulas and beta comparisons.
